# go-modern-bytes-clone

**Since:** Go 1.20

## Summary

Use bytes.Clone to copy a byte slice.

## Details

bytes.Clone communicates that a new byte slice is required.
It avoids append-copy boilerplate and preserves the standard library's nil-slice behavior.

## Examples

### Before

```go
copied := append([]byte(nil), b...)
```

### After

```go
copied := bytes.Clone(b)
```
